what.text: This page follows refugees from Sudan living in the United Kingdom, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 23603 Sudanese refugees in the United Kingdom, 0.8% of all refugees from Sudan.
Chad hosts the most Sudanese refugees, followed by South Sudan, Libya and Ethiopia.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Sudan from 1983 to 2018, at war level in many years, with the SPLM/A, NDA, JEM and SLM/A among the opponents.
From 2020 to 2025 it records armed conflict over the government of Sudan with the SLM/A, RSF, SPLM/A-North and SFA.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1988 at 56 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United Kingdom.
These are year-end totals for the United Kingdom only, reported to UNHCR.
